title: Continuation-Guided LLM Evolution of Program Policies and Goal Compilers in Craftax
abstract: arXiv:2611.19537v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can synthesize and optimize code-based policies from simulator feedback, allowing the resulting program to act with zero inference model calls. But for long horizon tasks, two challenges arise: local improvements can hurt final success and switching to a new objective requires another expensive synthesis run. We propose a framework that first develops competence by refining the policy through a feedback cascade, moving from episode returns to hierarchical goals and belief updates which can be scored densely from simulator. In the Craftax game, a partially observed and procedurally generated environment, refinements via episode level feedback stall at <1% final-level arrival, whereas with the feedback cascade the optimized policy reaches the final stage 50% of time (28% final boss defeats). translated_title: Craftax中基于续写引导的LLM程序策略与目标编译器演化
translated_abstract: 编码智能体能够从模拟器反馈中合成并优化基于代码的策略，使生成的程序在执行时无需任何推理模型调用。但对于长时程任务，存在两个挑战：局部改进可能损害最终成功率，且切换到新目标需要重新进行一次昂贵的合成运行。我们提出了一个框架，首先通过反馈级联来细化策略以培养任务能力，即从回合回报逐步过渡到层级目标和信念更新，这些内容可以从模拟器中获得密集的评分。在Craftax游戏——一个部分可观测且程序化生成的环境中——仅通过回合级反馈进行细化时，策略在最终关卡的到达率停滞在不到1%，而采用反馈级联后，优化后的策略有50%的概率到达最终阶段（28%的概率击败最终Boss）。此外，为了使这种能力能够复用于新目标，我们将先前的控制器分解为环境解释器 $I（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出反馈级联框架，通过从回合回报到层级目标的渐进式细化，将LLM演化的程序策略在Craftax中的最终关卡到达率从不足1%提升至50%，并将控制器分解为环境解释器与目标编译器以实现对新目标的复用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a feedback cascade framework that evolves LLM-synthesized program policies in Craftax from under 1% to 50% final-stage arrival by refining from episode returns to hierarchical goals, and factors the controller into an environment interpreter and goal compiler for reuse on new objectives.
